Title: ① Webflow Rebrand – Pat Szot

URL Source: http://patrickszot.webflow.io/recent-work/webflow-rebrand

Markdown Content:
At Webflow, I directly contributed to the product's rebrand, multiple years of conference creative, marketing campaigns, the production of many customer interviews, and foundational design systems across marketing touch-points.Together, our brand team blazed new paths in systemizing design/marketing decisions, collaborating with stakeholders, all while producing market-leading creative. I've collected some of my favorite executions here and hope we're able to chat more about workflow and production.
